question: Can an intact pretrained Llama-family sector contribute useful, measurable capability in a new Mamba-host pairing, against a matched random-sector twin?

child.trainable: input_seam and output_seam only (full-size dense, ~0.89M params)

protocol.metric: macro = mean(language, math) development token NLL, host tokenizer

gates.promotion: G_B and G_C at seed 42 AND seed-123 replication benefit >= 1%
gates.held_out: opened once only after promotion; otherwise NOT_RUN_NO_PROMOTION

outcomes.A: promotion gates pass and held-out confirms usefulness (language BPB ratio <= 1.50 vs host)
outcomes.B: replicated donor-specific benefit (G_B) but usefulness fails
outcomes.C: valid experiment, no reliable pretrained advantage (G_B fails)
outcomes.D: inconclusive due to documented technical/data/compute/measurement limitation
